subject: Urgent: token-replay & session-fixation follow-up — evidence handoff
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acme-corp.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 21:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: pen test token replay/session fixation traces & evidence request

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for taking the time on the call earlier today. Our pen-test report included a few high-severity items we need to close before the compliance window on Sep 15. For clarity I'm including the three findings we want evidence for and an ask for what to provide: 

- FND-01: token replay (access tokens can be replayed across sessions) — ask: patch or config diff + sanitized request traces showing nonce/anti-replay, and proof of mitigation applied to auth service.
- FND-07: session fixation via stale session IDs on redirect flow — ask: code diff/patch or WAF rule, and a short test plan we can run for verification.
- FND-12: auth logging gap (missing token change events in audit stream) — ask: sample sanitized logs (JSONL) and retention policy confirmation.

We attached a short excerpt from the pen test that shows the PoC steps (redacted). Can you confirm owners, ETAs for each artifact, and whether you can provide sanitized logs by end of day Monday (Aug 31)? Also confirm whether we should schedule a retest window (we have availability Sep 7–10).

Attachment: redwood_pen_test_excerpt.pdf (excerpt, 4 pages)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this is gating our SOC2 response.

—Evan
Evan Brooks
Security Engineer | Acme Logistics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acme-corp.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pen test token replay/session fixation traces & evidence request

Evan — thanks for the clear list and the excerpt. We're treating the three findings as high priority. Below is the remediation and evidence plan with owners and dates; we'll push artifacts into the Drive link and post the Jira updates to SEC-4821.

Summary of owners / deliverables / ETA
- FND-01 (token replay): Owner: Rishi Malhotra (Auth team). Mitigation: nonce + server-side anti-replay checks; patch applied to auth-service and a config toggle for rolling tokens. ETA for staged patch + config diff: 2026-09-10 (we're doing a canary rollout). Evidence we will provide: code diff (patch), sanitized request traces, and a short validation script.
- FND-07 (session fixation on redirect): Owner: Laura Bennett (Security Ops). Mitigation: enforce new-session-on-auth redirect + set SameSite/Lax, remove predictable session ids. ETA for patch + test plan: 2026-09-03. Evidence: patch file, automated test plan, and test output.
- FND-12 (auth logging gap): Owner: Laura Bennett (Security Ops) with infra. Mitigation: add token-change events to audit stream; wire to log-collector; retention policy update. ETA for sample logs (sanitized JSONL): 2026-08-30 EOD. Full retention policy doc update: 2026-09-02. Evidence: sanitized logs, retention doc, config diff.

Interim mitigations we've implemented today:
- Short-term WAF rule to detect token replay patterns (monitored) — will remain until token rolling is live.
- Increased TTL on session cookies to force rotation window until fix is deployed.

We're aiming to have the initial sanitized logs to you by end of day today (Aug 30). We'll attach the patch files and the code diffs to the SEC-4821 ticket and to the Drive folder once the canary passes smoke tests.

For retest window: we can support Sep 7–10. I'll mark SEC-4821 with the retest window you suggested.

If you need an on-call review session, I can make time Mon/Tue morning.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

---
Karthik Iyer
Redwood Inference
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acme-corp.com>

Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pen test token replay/session fixation traces & evidence request

Thanks Karthik — that helps. A couple of clarifying requests before we consume artifacts: 

- Log format: can you provide sanitized logs as JSONL with the following fields: timestamp, request_id, user_id (hashed), event_type, token_id (hashed), ip, user_agent. That will speed our triage.
- For the token-replay patch, can you also provide a short README that shows how the canary was performed (traffic % / timeframe) and the smoketest commands you ran?
- Confirm that the WAF mitigation will not be removed until we sign off on the retest.

If you can provide the logs and the README by EOD today, we'll queue the retest for Sep 8 (preferred). Otherwise Sep 9 is our fallback.

On the quoting:
> On Sun, Aug 30, 2026 at 9:05 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:

—Evan

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pen test token replay/session fixation traces & evidence request

Evan — attaching the artifacts we discussed. Below is a short rundown of what's included and next steps.

Attachments included (sanitized):
- sanitized-audit-logs-20260830.tar.gz — JSONL logs (fields: timestamp, request_id, user_hash, event_type, token_hash, ip, ua). Sample contains 2,400 events covering the last 24h (PII hashed).
- fix-token-replay.patch — patch for auth-service; includes server-side nonce checks and token-rolling toggle (commented).
- session-fix-plan.txt — test plan for session fixation validation and smoke script outputs.

What's been done:
- Logs: we've exported and sanitized the audit stream as requested (JSONL). File is in attachments and also uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_evidence
- WAF: rule will remain active until you sign off post-retest; we set an escalation to keep it enabled through Sep 12 to account for rollout variability.
- Canary: Rishi performed a 5% canary for the token-rolling change for 2 hours; smoke tests passed (see canary-smoke.txt in the Drive folder). Full rollout is gated on performance metrics and will proceed 2026-09-10.

Retest: we've reserved Sep 8 as requested. I've added a calendar hold and linked SEC-4821 to the retest. Once you confirm the time window on Sep 8 we'll provide a dedicated Slack channel and a point-of-contact for live verification.

Next steps / action items:
- Redwood: attach full code diff and README to SEC-4821 (SEC-4821 comment + Drive link) — owner: Rishi — ETA: 2026-09-10 for full release, README by 2026-08-30 (attached).
- Acme: confirm retest window for Sep 8 and preferred time (we can support 9–17 PDT).

If you need anything else for the SOC2 pack, let me know and I'll escalate.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: sanitized-audit-logs-20260830.tar.gz, fix-token-replay.patch, session-fix-plan.txt
